    assert handle_search_users({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})

    # We'll need to check the implementation later, but let's assume
    # we can search by "a" which matches Ada (name), ada@example.com (email)
    # and also "l" which matches Linus (name), linus@example.com (email)
    
    # Actually wait, let's look at the database again.
    # Ada (1) -> "ada", "ada@example.com"
    # Linus (2) -> "Linus", "linus@example.com"
    
    status, result = handle_search_users({"q": "Ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["id"] == 1
EOF
